A message is a COMMITMENT when the sender promises to do something themselves in the future.
Not a commitment: requests and questions to others, things already done, other people's promises,
maybes, refusals, plans being discussed, and plain chit-chat.

Add your own real messages to the matching list and re-run the training script. Everything stays on this machine.
